newsitem.title: USA: Christopher expected to fly to Israel at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Christopher expected to fly to Israel at weekend.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher is expected to set off for Israel on Saturday to push forward Israeli-Palestinian peace talks following a Middle East summit this week, U.S. government sources said on Friday.
The sources, who asked not to be identified, said Christopher would visit Israel for about a day at the start of an Africa tour starting on Monday.
The sources said Christopher would meet separately with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.

Israeli and Palestinian officials will meet on Sunday at Erez, on the border between Israel and the Gaza Strip, to discuss implementation of their peace accords, including an Israeli troop deployment in the West Bank town of Hebron.

The sources said it was not clear whether Christopher would attend those talks, in which Netanyahu and Arafat are not scheduled to take part. Washington has already announced that Middle East envoy Dennis Ross will attend the talks, organized in the wake of bloody Israeli-Palestinian clashes last week.
The sources said the State Department was expected to announce the trip later on Friday.
